statement.p: Find an equation of the tangent plane to the surface z = \frac{35}{5x+5y} at the point (3,4,1).

static.solution: f(x,y,z) = \frac{35}{5x+5y} - z, so the given surface is the level surface of f(x,y,z) = 0. Since \mbox{grad } f = \langle -\frac{175}{\left(5x+5y\right)^{2}}, -\frac{175}{\left(5x+5y\right)^{2}}, -1 \rangle, we have \mbox{grad } f(3,4,1) = \langle -\frac{175}{1225}, \frac{175}{1225}, -1 \rangle, and the equation of the tangent plane at 3, 4, 1 is -\frac{175}{1225} (x - 3) - \frac{175}{1225} (y - 4) - (z - 1) = 0, or z = 1 -\frac{175}{1225} (x - 3) - \frac{175}{1225} (y - 4).
